items.name: Read-only login
checks: Login mdqc_powerbi_ro can read the powerbi schema and nothing else (core, core_all, analytics, analytics_all, memory refuse a SELECT)
It cannot write anything: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE and a session that turns read-only off are all refused
Its password is typed by the user at a hidden prompt; it is never printed, logged or committed

items.name: Report views are right
checks: Every view in schema powerbi equals separate SQL on core_all and analytics_all (counts by product, quarter, event type, failure mode, company; recalls; battery families)
The views agree with the app's snapshot files where they overlap

items.name: Numbers in the report are right
checks: At least 12 values exported from report visuals (CSV via Export data) equal the verifier's own values

items.name: A complete report
checks: Four pages: Overview, Trends and failure modes, Companies and recalls, Battery investigation; same colours as the app
PDF export and a PNG of every page committed

items.name: Honest
checks: Every page carries the notes that report counts are not failure rates and that the latest quarter is incomplete; the battery page says the data cannot show cause
